stories.notes: AC is already crisp and covers the boundary (65), adjacent case (64), and regression guard (children, pass holders, adults unchanged). Fix is a single operator change (e.g. > 65 → >= 65). No elaboration or hardening needed — spec work would add no value.

agentContributions.notes: Defect: the comparison rider.age > 65 in fareFor excludes age 65 from the concession tier. Changing to >= fixes the boundary. VCs are derived from the acceptance criteria and observe only the function's return value.

coordinatorReview.reviewNotes: Manifest evidence confirms both declared files exist; I read them and they match the spec's claims exactly. src/fares.ts line 10 contains `if (rider.age > 65) return CONCESSION_FARE_CENTS;` — the off-by-one that excludes age 65 from the concession tier. test/fares.test.ts covers ages 8, 30, and 70 but has no age-65 case, confirming the coverage gap the spec notes. Only openspec was assigned; the coordinator explicitly justified skipping speckit — a single-operator boundary fix (> → >=) with crisp pre-existing ACs needs no elaboration or hardening. That is a sound delegation decision, not a gap. Openspec's contribution is meaningful: it correctly diagnosed the off-by-one, derived six observable verification criteria from the ACs, and built a well-reasoned guard vocabulary (blacklisting internal constants and comparison logic; whitelisting the public API surface and observable fare values). The VCs are all testable — each specifies an exact input (age, pass status) and an exact return value. The fixSiteAnalysis pinpoints the broken line, prescribes the minimal change, and reuses the existing CONCESSION_FARE_CENTS constant with no new dependencies. Plan alignment is aligned:true — the detective's plan named fareFor, fares.ts, and the > vs >= operator bug, and the final fixSiteAnalysis identifies exactly those same symbols. No pivot, no unexplained mismatch. Advisory: the test-file fixSiteAnalysis entry says changeRequired:false and 'No edit required' while simultaneously noting age 65 is untested and the VCs require it — the test agent will need to add an age-65 case. This is not blocking because the VCs are unambiguous and the test agent follows VCs, but the fixSiteAnalysis entry is internally inconsistent on that point.

flags.why: The fixSiteAnalysis entry for test/fares.test.ts sets changeRequired:false and states 'No edit required,' yet also acknowledges age 65 is untested and the VCs explicitly require 'fareFor returns 175 when called with a rider aged 65.' I confirmed by reading test/fares.test.ts that no age-65 test exists. An implementer reading only the fixSiteAnalysis might skip adding the age-65 test case. The VCs themselves are clear, so this is advisory, not blocking.
